_doc: Node-by-node audit of the viewer (two passes, 15 parallel Sol reviewers, spot-checked). Keys are pseudonymous participant IDs or KG person IDs; no raw header text is stored. Participants: boilerplate/ocr_garbage/redaction_or_placeholder are dropped, variant_of_known/fix_label with merge_into are merged into that graph person, group_or_role is flagged. Persons: boilerplate/ocr_garbage are flagged as parse artifacts, group_or_role as not an individual. ocr_merges: OCR-variant address merges (ocr_variant_of_more_frequent_address) where both Tesseract and RapidOCR re-read the variant itself on every official scan checked (scripts/reocr_full.py verdict same_garble), so the address may be genuinely different. They still merge but are marked confidence needs_review. luna_verdict: first-pass judgement by GPT-6-Luna on the real address pair (same = OCR damage of the target, different = plausibly a separate mailbox, unsure); reasons are kept privately in data/private/ocr_review/. review: second-pass decision on the real pair (same = confirmed OCR damage, merge stands and is no longer flagged; unsure = still needs_review; different = merge blocked). reocr: scripts/reocr_participants.py re-read of the header line on official scans (DOJ text layer, Tesseract, RapidOCR); the note says what the scan shows. not_a_name: Haiku sweep of all unreviewed visible participants, decided by Claude (2026-11-01): hidden in the viewer, never dropped; labels on a real mailbox stay. place: a header phrase that names a location (claude phrase review 2026-11-04): drawn as a location.
_public_repo: Withheld in the public repository: reviewed records about individuals (personal data). Format: see _doc.
